title: TaskAssign v1
description: hub->runner: assign one task to a role. The task payload is a stapel-taskspecs TaskSpec (validated by that library, not re-specified here). invocation carries the native model<->harness pairing and runtime wiring. seq places the frame in the hub's per-task outbound stream for resume/replay. Anti-cheat rules, permission policies and concrete system prompts are NOT part of this schema (moat, studio-design section 6).

task_id.description: Convenience mirror of task.id; the (task_id, seq) pair keys resume/replay.

task.description: A stapel-taskspecs TaskSpec object. Validated against the taskspecs schema by TaskAssign.validate(); kept as a generic object here to avoid a cross-package $ref.

role.description: Role the runner executes. Open string; the coder is the only role the runner runs (thin roles live in the control plane).

invocation.description: Native model<->harness pairing + runtime wiring. Fields are examples, not a closed set (routing config is host policy).

seq.description: Sequence number in the hub's per-task outbound stream.
